lines: You broke into the forge chest. That stock protects the village.
Smashing a weaponsmith chest is not borrowing. Explain yourself.
That chest held steel for village work, not a reward for your pickaxe.

options.label: Pay restitution
options.response: The chest can be replaced. The trust you broke is harder work.
responses: Payment helps settle the moment. Permission still comes before the latch.

take_items.success_response: A full stack of emeralds pays for the broken forge stock. It does not buy back trust.
success_responses: That payment covers the damage for now. The village will be watching what you do next.
take_items.failure_response: You cannot repay a smashed forge stockpile. Then words will not settle this.
failure_responses: Then you cannot settle this with payment or returns. Choose your next words carefully.

options.label: Apologize
responses: Apology heard. Better choices will matter more than better words.

options.label: Threaten them
responses: Then we are past warnings. Choose your next move carefully.

leave_option.label: Leave
leave_option.response: Break forge stores and walk away? No. I remember that.
responses: Leaving now is wiser than making this worse.

lines: That armorer chest was stocked for village defense. Why is it broken?
You broke a chest full of work meant to keep people alive.
I saw the armor stores break under your hand. Speak carefully.

options.label: Pay restitution
options.response: Armor takes dents so villagers do not. Village stores deserve better than that.
responses: Payment helps settle the moment. Permission still comes before the latch.

take_items.success_response: A full stack of emeralds pays for the broken armor stores. Next time, ask before you swing.
success_responses: That payment covers the damage for now. The village will be watching what you do next.
take_items.failure_response: You cannot repay what you broke. Then you cannot call this settled.
failure_responses: Then you cannot settle this with payment or returns. Choose your next words carefully.

options.label: It was an accident
options.response: One crack is an accident. A broken chest is a choice you kept making.
responses: Then learn from the accident before it becomes a habit.

options.label: Threaten them
responses: Then we are past warnings. Choose your next move carefully.

leave_option.label: Leave
leave_option.response: Walking away from broken armor stores is not harmless.
responses: Leaving now is wiser than making this worse.

lines: Every tool in that chest had a job. Breaking the chest was not one of them.
You smashed the tool stores. The village works with those.
I saw you break the toolsmith chest. Explain the damage.

options.label: Pay restitution
options.response: Tools can fix the chest. Trust needs better hands than yours showed today.
responses: Payment helps settle the moment. Permission still comes before the latch.

take_items.success_response: Forty-eight emeralds pays for the broken tool stores. Leave the rest where it belongs.
success_responses: That payment covers the damage for now. The village will be watching what you do next.
take_items.failure_response: You broke the tool stores and cannot repay them. That leaves anger.
failure_responses: Then you cannot settle this with payment or returns. Choose your next words carefully.

options.label: Apologize
options.response: Then make your apology useful: stop breaking village tools.
responses: Apology heard. Better choices will matter more than better words.

options.label: Threaten them
options.response: Tools are good at answering threats.
responses: Then we are past warnings. Choose your next move carefully.

leave_option.label: Leave
leave_option.response: Leaving the broken tool chest behind does not leave the blame behind.
responses: Leaving now is wiser than making this worse.
